verdict.line: You lose if you let Yorick stack Mist Walkers and wall you off from minions; you win if you burst him down before he digs his first grave.

brief.thesis: Yorick's Passive and Q (Last Rites) need time against a target to dig graves and summon Mist Walkers, so he wants slow, drawn-out trades; Renekton's W (Ruthless Predator) and E (Slice and Dice) give him a hard stun and gap-close to force a single fast burst before the Walkers show up. This lines up almost exactly with OP.GG's own read: apply pressure early and look for single bursts rather than extended fights, which is also why the measured 50.7% win rate over 1144 games sits essentially even.

theirWindow.what: If Mist Walkers are already out, back off trading in that spot — the extra bodies change the damage math in his favor. Reset to a part of the lane with no graves before you commit.

yourWindow.what: At 50+ Fury your W (Ruthless Predator) becomes a 3-hit stun that strips shields and hits much harder, and your Q (Cull the Meek) heals for more. Dump W into E (Slice and Dice) the instant Fury crosses that threshold rather than waiting for a bigger window.

start.why: 81% pick rate and the higher win rate of the two starts (49.7% over 1119 games) — the extra sustain and damage fuel the early all-in trades this matchup rewards.

boots.why: 81.4% pick rate; the attack reduction helps you survive Yorick's auto-reliant Q (Last Rites) trades once he starts stacking Walkers on you.

core.why: First item in the highest win-rate path (58.6% over 191 games) — the burst-on-two-hits pattern matches the single-burst game plan.
Second in that same 58.6% path, giving the armor shred and sustained pressure to break through once he walls you with W (Dark Procession).
Third item in the top path (58.6%, 191 games) — the damage-over-time conversion keeps you alive through drawn-out Walker swarms.

situational.when: you are getting bursted down before your stun combo finishes
the game is going long and you need more ability haste to keep resetting W (Ruthless Predator)
yorick is building sustain through his q (last rites) heal
their jungle or mid is piling on hard cc to lock you out of your stun window

runes.keystoneWhy: Matches the highest-played page (38.5% pick, 50.2% win rate) and rewards exactly the sustained-trade-into-burst pattern you want against a champion that out-sustains you if the fight drags.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite is run on 87.5% of Renekton picks in this matchup (49.7% win rate) — Ignite punishes Yorick's Q (Last Rites) healing and secures the burst kills this lane is built around.

playing.title: Trade only when Fury is high
playing.detail: Wait until your Fury bar crosses 50 before committing to W (Ruthless Predator) — the 3-hit empowered version stuns for 1.5 seconds and strips shields, versus the base 0.75-second stun.

playing.title: Punish before graves appear
playing.detail: Yorick's Passive and Q (Last Rites) need a dug grave to summon Mist Walkers. Engage early in a fight before any graves are on the ground so you're fighting only Yorick, not Yorick plus Walkers.

playing.title: Don't fight through his wall
playing.detail: W (Dark Procession) is a destructible wall on a 20/18/16/14/12s cooldown that blocks movement. If he drops it mid-trade, disengage rather than wasting time breaking it — walk around instead.

playing.title: Respect Mourning Mist poke
playing.detail: E (Mourning Mist) reduces your armor, damages, slows, and marks you on a 12/11/10/9/8s cooldown. If you're marked, expect summoned Walkers to gain move speed chasing you — disengage rather than facetank the follow-up.

playing.title: Use E to close and reset
playing.detail: E (Slice and Dice) on a 16/14.5/13/11.5/10s cooldown both closes the gap for your stun chain and, when empowered, cuts armor — use it to initiate, not just to escape.

playing.title: Hold R for forced extended fights
playing.detail: R (Dominus) grants bonus health and periodic Fury generation. Save it for moments you're stuck in a longer fight near his Maiden or Walkers rather than popping it on a clean single-target burst you can already win.

playing.title: Track his ultimate timer
playing.detail: R (Eulogy of the Isles) is on a long 160/130/100/100/100s cooldown and summons the Maiden, which raises Walkers from dead enemies. After level 11 ask your jungler to help contest objectives before his Maiden snowballs the sidelane.

brief.patchCaveat: Win rates, build paths, runes, and summoner spells above are measured from live games on the current patch (16.19.1) via OP.GG; the mechanical reasoning and timing advice are my own tactical read, not measured data.

stats.opponentTip: Apply pressure early game to Yorick to gain lane control. Rather than engaging in prolonged fights, try to deal single bursts of damage.
